text:
alex: GlacierTech put a conditional offer on the table for the EU wave — 20 refurbished H200s + 30 new H200s. Lead time for the mixed shipment is ~14 days, all-new is ~8 weeks. They want a decision by EOD.

maria: price delta? warranty parity? we should not take refurbished unless terms protect us.

jamal: runtime impact: are the refurbs firmware-matched to our fleet baseline? KV-cache/driver parity matters. mixing could cause perf noise in prod pools.

alex: vendor says refurbs are factory-refurb, full hardware swap, 12mo warranty, firmware can be matched but requires depot flash. They offered a 7% unit credit vs list for the refurbished line.

sylvie: customs flag: refurbs shipped as "used" might trigger different HS/code + duties. For EU that could add ~€400/unit unless reclassed. Need vendor to commit to export docs listing as "refurbished - same tariff" or we push to air to avoid sea hold.

maria: ok ask GlacierTech for: serial manifest pre-shipment, firmware build IDs, depot burn-in logs, DOA credit commitment, and photos of units/packaging. Also request commercial invoice reflecting tariff code we can clear.

procurement-bot: Vendor GlacierTech: proposed split shipped via FRA hub, AWB: GTX-FRA-2026-009 (air for 8 express), sea for remainder. Payment terms: Net30, holdback 5% until serial reconciliation.

jamal: if we accept conditional: route 20 refurbs to our FRA depot for 72h burn-in and HW tests, then push 10 to eu-west-1 production pool as a canary. Need automatic rollback plan to fallback nodes in the same rack if perf regresses.

alex: ops-oncall can you sketch the rollout steps? I want minimal customer impact.

ops-oncall: rollout sketch:
- FRA depot: receive -> manifest verify -> firmware parity flash if needed -> run burn-in (48h smoke + 24h stress).
- Tag units with temporary tag "GTX-REF-TRIAL" in inventory.
- Canary push: 10 units into staging farm, run 72h of perf traces on standard prompt set (p50/p99 tokens).
- If p99 > baseline+30ms or error rate >0.2% -> immediate quarantine + vendor RMA trigger.

sylvie: note: if customs reclass happens we won't be able to move units into EU pools without extra duties. Vendor needs to absorb or we need a credit line.

maria: negotiate: make the 7% credit contingent on successful burn-in + smoke. If units fail DOA within 30 days, vendor replaces with new units at no extra cost and covers return freight. Holdback 5% until serial reconciliation. Also ask vendor to waive tariff delta if classification triggers extra duties.

alex: vendor response (via email summary): GlacierTech ok to 5% holdback, will replace DOA within 10 business days, agrees to provide serial manifest 48h pre-shipment, but refuses to absorb unknown tariff reclass — they offered an additional 3% credit instead.

jamal: 3% + 7% = 10% total? vendor might intend credits additive but we should lock exact net unit price. Also confirm warranty extension if refurbs die after 6 months.

maria: counter: Accept the mixed shipment only if vendor:
- Guarantees firmware parity (vendor does flash at depot),
- Agrees to absorb up to €300/unit tariff delta or issue an escrow credit if reclass > €300,
- Commits to 12mo warranty on refurbs and immediate cross-ship replacement for DOA within 5 business days for the air-express 8 units, 10 business days for sea.

procurement-bot: GlacierTech replied: can do depot flash, will provide photos & manifest, warranty 12mo on refurbs, cross-ship 5bd for air units, 12bd for sea. No upfront tariff absorption but open to escrow credit on reconciliation.

sylvie: escrow credit is workable but we need a cap and reconciliation SLA. propose cap €400/unit, reconciliation window 60 days post-delivery.

alex: decision proposal: accept mixed shipment with conditions: depot burn-in mandatory, 5% holdback until serial reconciliation, vendor to provide manifest + photos 48h pre-ship, escrow credit capped €400/unit for tariff reclass, 12mo warranty, DOA cross-ship 5bd for air units. If GlacierTech won't sign we walk and push to new-only 8-week timeline.

maria: I'll send that as a tracked redline this afternoon.

jamal: add automated perf checks and a canary rollback policy in the rollout doc. I'll prep the test suite.

ops-oncall: I'll update runbooks: tagging, quarantine, and RMA flow. Also add a small metric dashboard for the canary cluster (p50/p95/p99, error %, VM evictions).

alex: thanks — we need vendor signoff by EOD. If they accept, route procurement to sign and logistics to schedule FRA depot inbound.

sylvie: note for docs: vendor wants sea packing list to show "refurbished - under warranty" verbatim to avoid customs delays. I'll include that phrasing in the PO.

maria: pinging legal for the tariff escrow language.

procurement-bot: Action items assigned: [maria] negotiate redline, [sylvie] confirm depot slot, [jamal] test-suite canary, [ops-oncall] update runbooks.

alex: quick ask to vendor if possible: can they pre-stage 4 tested air express units with serial photos on tarmac hold so we can swap into fleet if urgent? would reduce outage risk.

GlacierTech rep (via email): "We can pre-stage 4 express units for an additional expedite fee. If you want that we need a P.O. amendment."

alex: ok hold off on expedite until we see their acceptance of escrow terms.

sylvie: FYI port congestion note — if sea delays >7 days after ETD we escalate to air for the next batch.

maria: I'll wrap up negotiation and post the signed PO in this thread once done.

jamal: if anything slips, we should also look at temporary borrow from Dedicated partners (short-term loan) to cover any cluster deficits.

alex: agreed. good thread.
